description: Defines the CertVerifyProc class and related components for certificate verification in the Chromium project, including verification flags, factory methods, and verification process interface.

classes.name: CertVerifyProc
classes.description: Interface for performing certificate verification, including verification flags, support for additional trust anchors, and verification process.

classes.name: CertVerifyProcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CertVerifyProc with specific parameters.

classes.name: CertVerifyProc::ImplParams
classes.description: Struct holding parameters for creating CertVerifyProc instances, such as CRLSet and root store data.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification against a hostname with optional OCSP and SCT list, returning status code.

methods.name: SupportsAdditionalTrustAnchors
methods.description: Indicates if the implementation supports passing additional trust anchors.

methods.name: VerifyInternal
methods.description: Internal method to perform the actual verification, to be implemented by subclasses.
